capabilities.title: Azure control-plane collection
capabilities.scope: Subscription-first collector, subject to Azure RBAC and Graph permissions.
limitations: Does not inventory all Azure services or establish endpoint compliance.
Historical live assessments need scoped provenance review before admission to this register.

capabilities.title: AWS control-plane collection
limitations: Provider metadata remains research_preview; fake-client tests do not promote it to active.
SIGI historical assessments are not reclassified here; their original evidence needs separate admission review.

capabilities.title: Provider evidence contracts
capabilities.scope: Per-control support, permissions, freshness and sufficiency declarations.
limitations: Declared contracts are not proof that every permission or provider API has been exercised.

capabilities.title: Validated control metadata
capabilities.scope: Schema, registry and evaluator alignment for the baseline control pack.
limitations: Structural checks do not establish rule correctness or assessor approval.

capabilities.title: Decision provenance
capabilities.scope: Inspectable links between assessment decisions and their recorded evidence.
limitations: Traceability does not independently establish the truth or sufficiency of source evidence.

capabilities.title: Budget-aware remediation planning
capabilities.scope: Heuristic prioritization and budget-constrained remediation scenarios.
limitations: Estimated effort and simulated benefits are not measured customer savings or incident-risk reduction.

capabilities.title: Cyber Essentials pre-population
capabilities.scope: Draft questionnaire evidence with explicit unresolved/manual-evidence requirements.
limitations: Does not certify Cyber Essentials or replace an assessor.
Practitioner feedback is distinct from an independently adjudicated answer-pack evaluation.

capabilities.title: Healthcare and IoMT evidence pack
capabilities.scope: Cloud-side healthcare/IoMT mappings and evidence pack.
limitations: Not medical-device inspection, clinical safety validation or a certification.

capabilities.title: Local console assessment workflows
capabilities.scope: Report selection, findings, artifacts and mocked scan lifecycle in desktop Chromium.
limitations: Fixture-backed browser tests are not live-provider or multi-tenant security tests.
Mobile and other browser engines are not covered by this browser gate.

capabilities.title: Installed local runtime
capabilities.scope: Installed sdist/wheel and supervised private single-operator runtime.
limitations: Not approved for unauthenticated shared or public deployment.

capabilities.title: GCP collection
capabilities.scope: Planned active GCP collector; existing placeholder is not an active provider path.

capabilities.title: Hosted tenant isolation
limitations: Current local runner is not suitable for shared multi-organization hosting.

capabilities.title: Post-quantum cryptography discovery
capabilities.scope: Planned CRIS-PQC discovery and migration evidence.
limitations: No released PQC discovery or quantum-safety assurance claim.
